tn_right_bunker_the.blurb: A steep, overhanging sandstone section of Foster Falls, near Jasper west of Chattanooga, sitting just beyond the Crime Buttress. This is the hard end of the cliff: of its 11 sport routes, six are in the 5.13 range, and the rest split between 5.11 and 5.12. A large roof defines the wall, so expect powerful, sustained pulling rather than easy leads. Come here for a project day when you are comfortable leading well into the 5.12s; the gentler warm-ups are found elsewhere along the cliff.

tn_art_of_the_vogi_boulder.blurb: A single boulder in the Front Area of Stone Fort, in the wooded boulder field beside the Montlake golf course north of Chattanooga. It holds 11 problems, mostly V2 to V5, plus one hard V7 sit start on the back face. The namesake line is a V4 that has been repeated many times and is a well-known classic of the area, with a left variation a notch harder. It makes a quick, popular stop as you work through the first cluster of boulders, reached by walking the climbers' path down the hill into the field.

tn_fish_market_boulder.blurb: A boulder in the Jungle Gym and Fromundathunda area of Stone Fort, near Soddy-Daisy north of Chattanooga, found beyond the Front Area along the main trail. It carries 11 problems, from a pair of easy V0 lines through a cluster of V3 and V4 problems to a single V7. The namesake V4 is a short, steep sit start finishing on a topout, and a traverse and several neighbouring lines sit within a few steps. Bring a pad or two and a spotter for a compact session of mostly moderate problems.
